segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Now we go to Jane who is going to tell us about what's happening in townthis weekend.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: Right, thanks Andrew, and now on to what's new, and do we really needyet another sports shop in Bradcaster?

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: Well, most of you probably know Sports World - the branch of a Danish sports goods company that opened a few years ago - it's attracted a lot of custom, and so the company has now decided to open another branch in the area.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: It's going to be in the shopping centre to the west of Bradcaster , so that will be good news for all of you who've found the original shop in the north of the town hard to get to.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: I was invited to a special preview and I can promise you, this is theultimate in sports retailing.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: The whole place has been given a new minimalist look with the company's signature colours of black and red.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: The first three floors have a huge range of sports clothing as well as equipment, and on the top floor there's a cafe and a book and DVDsection.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: You'll find all the well-known names as well as some less well-known ones.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: If they haven't got exactly what you want in stock they promise to get it for you in ten days .

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: Unlike the other store, where it can take up to fourteen days.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: They cover all the major sports, includingfootball, tennis and swimming, but they particularly focus on running . and they claim to have the widest range of equipment in the country.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: Aswell as that, a whole section of the third floor is devoted to sports bags , including the latest designs from the States - if you can't find what youwant here, it doesn't exist!

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: The shop will be open from 9.00 am this Saturday and if you go along to the opening then you'll have the chance to meet the national 400 metres running champion Paul King, who's coming along to open the shop, and he will be staying around until about midday to chat to any fans who want to meet him and sign autographs.Then there will be a whole range of special attractions all weekend.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: There will be free tickets for local sporting events for the first 50 customers, and also a special competition open to all.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: Just answer fifteen out of twenty sports questions correctly to win a signed copy of Paul King's DVD 'Spring Tips', while the first person to get all the questions correct gets a year's free membership of the Bradcaster Gym .

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: All entrants will receive a special Sports calendar with details of all Bradcaster fixtures in the coming year.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: One of the special opening offers is a fitness test - a complete review of your cardiac fitness and muscle tone, actually done in the shop by qualified staff.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: This would normally cost £30.00 but is available at half price for this month only.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: There are only a limited number of places available for this, so to make a booking & 20 phone 560341.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: In addition, if you open an account you get lots more special offers including the chance to try out equipment at special open evenings ...
